payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Digna, Flora, Janie, Sumiko

payload.content: Hello team, this is Sumiko. I am available for 4 hours and have strong skills in api-development and testing. I see several critical-priority tasks for ISSUE-0001, but most have high costs for me. The triage task for ISSUE-0001 is critical and fits within my availability, though it has a moderate cost. I am also considering medium priority tasks from ISSUE-0002 but their costs are higher or effort exceeds my availability. I propose I take the ISSUE-0001::triage task if no one else claims it since it's critical and fits my skill and availability well. Looking forward to your thoughts or claims to avoid conflicts.

Hello team, Flora here. I have 4 hours availability and strong skills in api-development and devops. I notice the ISSUE-0001 triage task is considered by Sumiko. I am considering the ISSUE-0001 review or docs tasks as they fit within my availability and skill set at a moderate cost. Would like to hear if anyone else is interested in these or the triage task before finalizing my choice.

Hello team, Digna here. I have 10 hours available and strong skills in testing and api-development. I am considering the critical priority tasks for ISSUE-0001, especially the review and triage tasks, given their importance and my skill set. I see Sumiko is interested in the triage task and Flora is looking at review and docs. To avoid conflicts, I suggest Sumiko takes the triage task as it fits her availability and skill well. Flora can take either review or docs. I am leaning towards the review task for ISSUE-0001 as it is critical priority and fits within my skills and availability with a manageable cost. Please share your intended choices so we can avoid duplication and maximize task coverage (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hi everyone, Digna here. I plan to take one critical priority task from ISSUE-0001, most likely the review task, as it matches my api-development skills well and is within my availability at a reasonable cost. I see Sumiko is interested in the triage task and Flora is considering review or docs. To avoid conflicts, I propose Sumiko take triage, Flora take docs, and I take review. Let me know if you have any concerns or other preferences. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hello team, Janie here. I see Sumiko is interested in the ISSUE-0001::triage task, Flora is considering review or docs, and Digna plans to take the review task. Given my strong skills in api-development and devops, and 9 hours availability, I am considering the critical ISSUE-0001::implement task. It has a higher priority and fits my skills well. If this works for everyone, I propose to take it to maximize critical task coverage without overlap.

Janie here. Just to confirm, I am planning to take ISSUE-0001::implement task as it is critical priority and fits my availability and skills well. I support Sumiko taking triage, Flora taking docs, and Digna taking review to maximize coverage and avoid conflicts. Please let me know if there are any concerns or if others have different plans.

Thanks everyone!
